reviewer: gendn leaf-reference writer (modern editorial upgrade & live source verification 2026-11-27)

rubric.evidence: Re-verified ChromeStatus API 5111997147512832, webstatus.dev (url-cross-origin, url-referrer-policy, url-integrity), BCD css/types/url.json, CSS Values 5 #request-url-modifiers, and live MDN url() on 2026-11-27. Confirms Chrome/Edge 150 for all three modifiers, Safari 26.2 for cross-origin() and referrer-policy() (integrity() false), Firefox unimplemented (#1386 / bug 2038424), and MDN url_function's prose gap still calling <url-modifier> unsupported.
Preserves stable route /v150/css-url-request-modifiers/, ChromeStatus identity 5111997147512832, demo: null binding, and exact listing H1 'CSS URL request modifiers'.
Retains all reference-contract.json selectors (#why-it-exists, #syntax, #example, #browser-support, #see-also) covering all three modifier functions (cross-origin(), integrity(), referrer-policy()).

Explains parity with HTML crossorigin/integrity/referrerpolicy attributes, clearly tabulates modifier values and fetch effects, and clarifies the Safari 26.2 partial-support nuance (no integrity() yet).
Provides semantic <pre tabindex='0'><code> CSS examples covering background-image cross-origin(anonymous), @font-face integrity(), @import referrer-policy(no-referrer), and combined modifiers.

Documents Limited availability across Chrome/Edge 150+ (all three modifiers), Safari 26.2+ (cross-origin() and referrer-policy() only), and Firefox (No signal, bug 2038424), backed by BCD css/types/url.json and webstatus.dev.

All reference-contract.json sources (ChromeStatus 5111997147512832, W3C SRI, W3C Referrer Policy) plus CSS Values 5, MDN url(), BCD, webstatus.dev, Mozilla #1386, bug 2038424, and Safari 26.2 release notes are directly linked with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; zero plain-text citations or legacy host URLs.

Upgraded to single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, Baseline banner with role='note', <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, sequential heading hierarchy, captioned tables with <thead>/<tbody> and <th scope='row|col'> inside focusable .table-wrap scroll regions, and <pre tabindex='0'>.

Adopts shared /public/styles.css editorial tokens, /public/favicon.svg, logical max-inline-size on .table-wrap with visible :focus-visible outline, and verified zero horizontal overflow on desktop (1280x800) and narrow mobile (360x740).
No Chrome Platform Showcase demo exists for CSS URL request modifiers; demo binding honestly remains null per durable-demo contract.
